summary: 'unable to enter configuration mode' on EOS and IOS means a privileged task ran in user mode; fix with network_cli and become: true.
questions: How do I fix unable to enter configuration mode?
Why can't my IOS task enter config mode?

answer_card.title: Fix 'unable to enter configuration mode'
answer_card.answer_md:
The task needs privileged mode but ran in user mode (Arista EOS, Cisco IOS). Use:
```yaml
connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
become: true
become_method: enable
```
